command: seren agent cloud deployment status 7a000033-0000-4000-8000-000000000034 -o json
claim: Asking for the status of a deployment ID the owner never received returns the documented not-found answer, not another deployment's state or a success.

scope.statement: Status lookup for generated negative-test deployment UUID 7a000033-0000-4000-8000-000000000034, as an owner would after a mistyped or stale ID. The UUID was generated locally (version 4) on 2026-10-13T11:59:09Z and is not verified as never issued by Seren. A pass verifies only the documented not-found answer for this one identifier.
scope.entry: seren agent cloud deployment status <deployment-id> -o json
out_of_scope: Starting, stopping or modifying any deployment
Deleted deployments, other owners' deployments and general access-control testing
Malformed identifiers and the CLI's local argument validation
Wording or helpfulness of the error message

basis.reference: Handover example. Synthetic identifiers and generalized regression expectations; no live result or authority is transferred.
Handover example. Synthetic identifiers and generalized regression expectations; no live result or authority is transferred.

expectation_notes: Documented requirement: the 404 Not found response. The CLI prints the status, not the body, so 'deployment not found' text and a bare 404 are both the documented answer.
Hypothesis, not documented: a returned deployment object is unexpected because the UUID is not visible to the caller. It is an uncertain finding, since the UUID is not verified as never issued.
A success without a data object is neither documented answer and stays unverified.

Answer-class table (decided before execution): not_found pass; deployment_missing pass; record fail (uncertain finding); missing_object unverified; auth_rejected and forbidden unverified (access problem; a 403 may also be a visibility answer and is not interpreted); service_error unverified; unclassified unverified.
No live read was made while defining this case.

criteria.claim: A generated negative-test deployment ID returns the documented not-found answer
criteria.evidence: Classified answer per the declared table: documented not-found passes; a returned deployment fails as an uncertain finding; other classes stay unverified.
